Question B-001-016-009.

Why the correct answer is right: Fast-scan television on 145 MHz is the prohibited combination because that occupied bandwidth does not fit the 2-metre limit.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "FT8 on 14.074 MHz": FT8 on 14.074 MHz is not the prohibited combination in this question.
- sourceIndex 2: "Morse radiotelegraphy (CW) on 10.145 MHz": CW on 10.145 MHz is compatible with the narrow-band context named in the choices.
- sourceIndex 3: "Fast-scan television (ATV) on 440 MHz": Fast-scan television on 440 MHz is not the prohibited example selected by the bank.
